title: Bohemian Switzerland Gorges
slogan: A 285 km loop out of Bohemian Switzerland Gorges
story: A proper escape from Prague with roads worth waking up for. Out of Neratovice and back again: 245 km, roughly 5 h 07 in the saddle. On the way it passes Dolní Břežany and Klobuky. Bohemian Switzerland Gorges is the high point. The line favours views over speed. The plan has 1 food stop and 1 fuel stop marked.
